**Bedrock IP:** `play.discrealms.net` | **Port:** `19132`


**Servers**
* Disc Realms: Anthala (Towny)

---

![About Disc Realms Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f89892cf514f6beec73bea76b987902ad7809ed6.png)
## About Disc Realms

**Disc Realms Network** is a competitive, community-driven Minecraft server built for players who want more than just another reset cycle. We focus on long-term progression, meaningful conflict, player-driven economies, and custom systems designed from the ground up.

Whether you thrive in PvP domination or prefer building nations and shaping global politics, Disc Realms offers a world where your actions matter.

---

## Disc Realms: Anthala

![Disc Realms Anthala Banner Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac313cf4426a60598208250494f4b5a8569ffb7e_0.webp)

Pronounced `/ˈænθələ/`, **Anthala** represents our most ambitious project yet, a complete reimagining of Towny gameplay.

This isn’t a seasonal map. This isn’t a reset-based server. This is a persistent world built to evolve over time based on player lore and server driven events!

Anthala expands the traditional Towny experience with fully custom systems, player-driven lore, and a global economy that reacts to the actions of its nations.

### What Makes Anthala Different?

* **No Resets**: Your towns, nations, and history remain. This world is permanent and will only be expanded through future updates.
* **Player-Driven Lore**: The story of the server is shaped by wars, alliances, betrayals, and diplomacy happening throughout the server.
* **Global Market Economy**: Resources are finite and controlled by players. Trade routes, monopolies, and supply chains matter in the economy.
* **Warfare System**: Nation conflicts with meaningful consequences to lore.
* **Zero Pay-to-Win**: All core gameplay features are accessible without paid ranks. No unfair advantages are given on Anthala.

**Online Map:** [https://map.discrealms.net/](https://map.discrealms.net/)

<details>
<summary>Potential Discontinuation by October 2026</summary>
Note: Anthala may be discontinued in the future due to financial issues caused by bad actors who caused harm to our studio. We are deeply sorry for this. But Anthala will remain online until our dedicated machine expires.
</details>

---

## Semi-Anarchy

![Disc Realms: Semi-Anarchy Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d514bd7a2f24f3cbc6617f1619f956ce7ddce1cf_0.webp)

For players who prefer chaos and competitive dominance. Hunt players, raid bases, and create new ones from the ground up. Focused on creating masterpieces, public projects, and so much more that bring lore and content to keep the server fun to play.

* Clan-based warfare: Form clans, rivalries, and dominate the server with constant fights at spawn. 
* Shop Economy: An in-game server shop to allow you to buy what you need to assist you and your fellow basemates or friends build structures, and help with advancing towards becoming stronger.
* Weekly Events: Take part in weekly events that allow your clan to dominate event histories and give you the chance to win free prizes such as ranks, in-game items, and potentially *free* merch.

---

![About Network Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7590275a79e32083d34cf9ef1787bf0fcbd926cd.png)
## Network Features

* **Active Moderation**: Dedicated staff focused on fair gameplay!
* **Optimized Anti-Cheat**: Competitive PvP without lag or unfair advantages!
* **Crossplay Support**: Java and Bedrock players can play together!
* **Full Documentation**: Detailed systems explained on our Wiki, so you do not feel lost!

We host events on a weekly basis, ranging from competitions to giveaways. We try to maintain an active community for all to enjoy!

Join the Discord to stay updated:

* Announcements
* Patch notes
* War declarations
* Events
* Giveaways
* Community discussions
